patterns.note: Generous horizontal padding creates a narrow central content column on wide screens, emphasizing readability and an editorial feel.
High-contrast typography pairs an oversized, elegant serif for primary headings with a clean, smaller sans-serif for body text and a distinct monospace for uppercase labels.
A dominant off-white background and dark grey text are subtly accented with muted, earthy tones (greens, blues, browns) used sparingly for small text elements and links.
The primary navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after the hero section scrolls past, maintaining its transparent background.
Accordion-style content sections are used to organize information, but appear fully expanded on page load rather than requiring user interaction to reveal content.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar transitions to a fixed position at the top of the viewport once the initial hero content has scrolled out of sight, retaining its original transparent background. Content sections simply scroll into view without any additional reveal animations.
Content is presented within a constrained maximum width, creating generous side margins on larger screens, which contributes to an airy, editorial aesthetic.

A strong typographic hierarchy is established by pairing a large, elegant serif font for main headings with a clean sans-serif for body text and a distinct monospace font for smaller, uppercase labels.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif hero heading (~4-5x body) paired with smaller, uppercase monospace labels and a legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced density within content blocks.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its strong editorial aesthetic, achieved through the prominent use of an oversized, elegant serif typeface for headings and a minimalist, airy layout with generous white space. It feels more like a sophisticated print publication than a typical corporate website, conveying authority and gravitas through its refined simplicity.
